ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the response of Governor Tim Walz.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and examining public records, we can determine the extent of the fraud and identify potential perpetrators.
